A node not in the handler's layout returns at 'if (!column) return;' and the caller refreshes with nothing said. The click handler only skips a disabled arrow (case-map.mjs:501) and nodeEditHtml never disables one (case-map.mjs:284-289). The manual comparator puts an unplaced node at Infinity (case-layout.mjs:55), so the drawn-only nodes sink below the ones the handler numbered. No test reads a move's result: R3661 (tests-tier0.mjs:24731-24735) presses with a stand-in onMove that only records ['move', id, step]. The function's own comment (investigation.mjs:1923) says 'the column as it is drawn now', which the code does not do.
